targetText: the “physical” idealism of today, just as the “physiological” idealism of yesterday, merely means that one school of natural scientists in one branch of natural science has slid into a reactionary philosophy, being unable to rise directly and at once from metaphysical materialism to dialectical materialism.
explanation: Lenin's brilliant diagnosis of the crisis of modern science: physicists trained in mechanical materialism slide into idealism when confronted with new subatomic realities, because they fail to grasp the dialectical nature of matter and cognition.
